text.en:
Subsection (f) of section three hundred and forty-four of the Administrative Code is hereby
amended to read as follows:
"(f) Machinery, which term shall embrace machines, mechanical contrivances, instruments, tools, implements,
appliances, and apparatus used for industrial, agricultural, or manufacturing purposes: Provided, That until
December thirty-one, nineteen hundred and twenty-two, sheds built in accordance with law and used
exclusively for the curing of tobacco shall also be included as property exempt from tax under this
subsection."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 21, 1918.
